description: Call this when a user asks for a recipe or for what to cook. Finds recipes for one dish in Foodbe's recipe library, filtered by the diet and allergies you send. Returns outcome "served" with a text line and recipe cards: name, image, a short fact, servings, prep time, cook time and calories. Every recipe comes from Foodbe's stored data, never from a model. If no recipe matches, it returns outcome "not_found".

allergies.description: Optional allergens to leave out, for example Peanuts.

diet.description: Optional diet to filter by, for example Vegan.

dish.description: The dish to find a recipe for, for example lasagna.

name: foodbe_recipe_finder
